description: Ground truth for fixtures/vuln-app. Every planted vulnerability is listed here; e2e tests assert these are detected (recall) and e2e clean-app tests assert no confirmed medium+ findings on the hardened twin (precision). Categories follow the official OWASP Top 10:2025 CWE mappings.

items.name: Missing security headers (CSP, XCTO, XFO, Referrer-Policy)
Verbose stack trace on error path
Unencoded reflection of query parameter (reflected XSS risk)
Server banner disclosing framework and version
Cleartext HTTP for credential-bearing login form
Username enumeration via differential login responses
No rate limiting on authentication endpoint
IDOR: order objects accessible without authorization
